title: “Article 61” of Magna Carta doesn’t allow you to ignore Covid-19 regulations – Full Fact
summary: Full Fact check: Clause 61 of the 1215 Magna Carta gave powers to 25 barons only, was dropped from later versions, and does not let anyone ignore Covid rules.

assertions.quote: It did not allow the general population to rebel, and it was also removed from subsequent versions of the document.
“Article 61” of Magna Carta doesn’t allow you to ignore Covid-19 regulations
